text.p: - Russia has written off $1 bln of Peruvian state debt.
Peruvian sources say Lima returned $160 mln worth of Russian bonds in exchange.
- The article of the constitution dealing with presidential health problems is extremely vague and probably needs an extra law to clarify things.
- It would be a grave mistake if the new $10 border tax -- to be paid by all travellers and cargoes crossing the frontier -- were introduced.
- Russia could ruin its recent warmer relations with Tokyo if it does not offer Japan formal apologies for having polluted its coastline.
- The State Duma moves to dismiss President Yeltsin on grounds of bad health.
- Belarus Popular Front pickets Russian embassy in Minsk to protest against possible union of the two countries.
- Russia turns to the idea of a union with Belarus for a third time in six years.
- Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko has to speed up economic and political reforms if a union with Russia is to succeed.
- Three paintings worth at least $500,000 have been stolen from a Moscow flat in what may turn out to be one of the biggest burglaries in the capital in 1997.
